title: Haymarket Branch Impacted by Construction

## ALERT: Haymarket Branch Impacted by Construction


**Virginia National Bank's location at 15240 Washington Street in Haymarket will be impacted by Chick-fil-A construction next to the property. Construction is scheduled to begin on July 11, 2026.**


We encourage Haymarket clients to temporarily visit one of our nearby locations for any in-person services:


**The Plains**
6464 Main Street
The Plains, VA 20198


**New Baltimore**
5119 Lee Highway
Warrenton, VA 20187


**Sudley Road**
8091 Sudley Road
Manassas, VA 20109


**[Click here](https://www.vnb.com/contact-us/office-locations-directions)** for all VNB locations.


**We apologize for the inconvenience and appreciate your patience during this time.**
